title: Beyoncé's Record-Breaking Grammy Night, in 30 Seconds
description:
At the 65th Grammy Awards in February 2023, Beyoncé won best dance/electronic music album for Renaissance, her fourth award of the night, taking her career total to 32: the most Grammys of any artist at the time. Totals have been reported differently since; this video states the figure from the 2023 ceremony.
